summary: EchoStar Corp filed an 8-K reporting the immediate resignation of CEO Hamid Akhavan from all positions with EchoStar and Hughes Satellite Systems, effective July 6, 2026, following board discussions on a strategic shift. Charles W. Ergen assumes Principal Executive Officer of Hughes. Akhavan will consult through December 31, 2026. His outstanding options are accelerated to vest immediately. This is an abrupt, forced departure tied to a change in strategic direction, constituting a management change event. Watch for potential further executive transitions or strategic pivots.
